title: CUK Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: Central University of Kerala (CUK) has declared the official notification for 2026. To fill up the vacancies for various Junior Research Fellow Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech, M.E/ M.Tech in Civil Engineering can use this chance and apply for the CUK Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
